_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Complacency with flat 30d momentum and no fired breaker, so the statistically honest call is continued coil rather than a forced leg.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase or direction (metals tape only)
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-55 and 30d momentum stays near flat with ETF flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks below 39 or above 62, or ETF flows reverse hard as 30d momentum leaves the flat band
